1.5K views · 140 reactions | Trump is 19 points underwater in Ohio. One week out. 📉

I pulled up the Civiqs tracker this morning and went through it group by group. 56% of Ohioans disapprove. Voters 18 to 34? 67% disapprove. Independents, the folks who usually swing elections here? Only 1 in 4 approve. 91% of Black Ohioans disapprove. 76% of postgrad women disapprove, and I still can't explain the other 20%.

The only age group still giving him the thumbs up is 65+, at 49 to 46. Fox News paid $787.5 million to Dominion over its 2020 election lies, and some folks are still tuned in.

Early voting is open in person through Sunday, Nov. 1. Already have a mail ballot? Drop it off at your county board of elections instead of trusting the mail.

Trump isn't on the ballot in November, but Trumpism sure is. Vote early, in person, and bring a friend or family member. Once you vote, campaigns take you off their call, text and door-knock lists, and those volunteers can go knock on doors that still need it.

Data: Civiqs tracking poll, Ohio registered voters, Oct. 27, 2026.
